parameters.content:
## Competitor product & page alert (sitemap changes)
Every morning the [Sitemap Change Monitor](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/sitemap-change-monitor) reads your competitors' sitemaps and compares them with yesterday. New and removed product pages go to Google Sheets and a Slack digest.

**Setup (5 min)**
1. *Check competitor sitemaps*: Header Auth credential `Authorization` = `Bearer <Apify API token>`.
2. Edit `domains` and `includePatterns` (e.g. `/products/`, `/blog/`, `/collections/`).
3. Connect Google Sheets (tab `Changes`) and Slack.

The first run only saves a baseline (no Slack message). Cost: $0.003 per domain checked, 5 competitors daily = about $0.45/month.

nodes.name: Check competitor sitemaps
nodes.notes: Runs apify.com/fast_data_asap/sitemap-change-monitor. The saved state per stateKey + domain lives in your Apify account, so each run reports changes since the previous run.
